title: Isolation and confinement
text: Small crews in closed habitats face monotony, sleep disruption, and strain on mood and team dynamics.
Countermeasures are scheduled sleep, a stable day-night routine, private psychological support, and protected crew time together.
Log sleep and mood honestly; the data only helps if it is true.

citations.source: NASA Human Research Program: the five hazards of human spaceflight — isolation and confinement.
